Empty by design — see ../README.md for sourcing.

Operators populating this directory should source from:

- ISIC Archive (https://www.isic-archive.com/) — most images are CC0
  with explicit `dataset.gallery` licensing. Filter by `cc0=true`
  before downloading.
- Kaggle `nodoubttome/skin-cancer9-classesisic` mirrors a CC0 ISIC
  subset; verify the per-image license tag before committing.

Each committed image MUST be sourced from a public-domain or CC0
archive. Tests that need this fixture call `pytest.skip` when only the
placeholder is present.
